definitions.explanation: The middle value in a data set when all values are arranged in order. A statistical measure used as an alternative to the average because it is less affected by extreme values.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年収|ねんしゅう}→年収：05504_nenshuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{中央値|ちゅうおうち}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{約|やく}→約：09563_yaku⟧400{万円|まんえん}だ。
examples.english: The median annual income is approximately 4 million yen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{平均値|へいきんち}→平均値：30167_heikinchi⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧{中央値|ちゅうおうち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{実態|じったい}→実態：10567_jittai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{反映|はんえい}している→反映する：17186_haneisuru⟧。
examples.english: The median reflects the actual situation better than the average.

examples.japanese: ⟦{住宅|じゅうたく}→住宅：03280_juutaku⟧⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{中央値|ちゅうおうち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{前年|ぜんねん}→前年：23906_zennen⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{上昇|じょうしょう}した→上昇する：21681_joushousuru⟧。
examples.english: The median housing price rose compared to the previous year.

notes:
A statistical term composed of ⟦{中央|ちゅうおう}→中央：03475_chuuou⟧ (center; middle) and {値|ち} (value). The {中央値|ちゅうおうち} is frequently used in news and economic reporting because, unlike the ⟦{平均値|へいきんち}→平均値：30167_heikinchi⟧ (mean/average), it is not skewed by extremely high or low values. This makes it especially useful for income, housing prices, and other data with uneven distributions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{年収|ねんしゅう}→年収：05504_nenshuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{中央値|ちゅうおうち}: median income
- {中央値|ちゅうおうち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}める→求める：02316_motomeru⟧: to calculate the median
- {中央値|ちゅうおうち}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{平均値|へいきんち}→平均値：30167_heikinchi⟧: median and average

- ⟦{平均値|へいきんち}→平均値：30167_heikinchi⟧: average; mean — the sum of all values divided by the count
- {最頻値|さいひんち}: mode — the most frequently occurring value in a data set
- ⟦{偏差値|へんさち}→偏差値：08553_hensachi⟧: deviation score — a standardized score used heavily in Japanese education
